name: devprofile-project
description: DevProfile: Unified student developer analytics, streak tracker, weakness analyzer, AI daily planner, and LinkedIn draft generator.

scripts.postinstall: cd backend && npm install --include=dev && cd ../frontend && npm install --include=dev
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.render:build: cd backend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
